finding.summary: We should check if `DOKKU_PROCFILE` exists. If an app is not deployed but a user calls `ps:scale`, then no Procfile is extracted, and this will probably fail.

label: real_issue
label_reason: A human reviewer raised this in dokku/dokku#3703 (merged 2019-10-04), and a later commit in the PR changes the file.
notes: Hand-picked with Claude Code (PMAT-310): https://github.com/dokku/dokku/pull/3703. Bash: reads a file that may not exist when the app has not been deployed. Human reviewers are not perfect ground truth, and they give no severity, so any severity counts.
